day_ahead.marine_summary: Forecast: SW 15–20 kt easing to 10–15 kt; seas 4–6 ft. Morning showers and storms; improving later.
day_ahead.storm_outlook: Post-Tropical Isaias is inland and weakening. Its remnants bring morning rain and storms; no direct tropical-wind threat to Coastal Georgia.

stories.headline: Drone attacks disable three Yandex data centers
stories.summary: Yandex said a drone attack shut its Vladimir-region data center, the third major facility disrupted in days. No injuries were reported; Ukraine had not confirmed responsibility.

stories.headline: Trump calls for replacing Ukraine's Zelenskiy
stories.summary: Trump called for replacing Zelenskiy amid a dispute over a US-Russia diesel deal. Kyiv says easing sanctions rewards Moscow; talks continue and the deal's market effect remains uncertain.

stories.headline: Saudi airport attack kills 12
stories.summary: An attack on Riyadh's international airport killed 12 people and wounded more than 300, Saudi authorities said. Houthis renewed warnings to airlines; attribution and damage claims remain contested.

stories.headline: World Bank discusses crisis aid with 30–40 nations
stories.summary: The World Bank is discussing crisis aid with 30–40 countries facing energy shocks and price increases from the Middle East war. Any packages and conditions remain under negotiation.

stories.headline: Pope opposes planned US military execution
stories.summary: Pope Leo condemned capital punishment as Trump weighs livestreaming Nidal Hasan's December military execution. No final decision on a broadcast has been announced.
